missing_evidence: Order service server-side latency and error metrics for /v1/orders
candidates.statement: Gateway checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its POST /v1/orders call to the order service times out (transport ReadTimeout), while inventory reservation succeeds; the order service's downstream payment authorization call also times out, indicating downstream latency in the order/payment path.
candidates.uncertainty: No order/payment service-side telemetry; cannot confirm whether latency originates in order or payment.

report.explanation: Gateway traces and logs show checkout 502s driven by ~2s transport ReadTimeouts on POST /v1/orders to the order service; inventory reservation succeeds. Order's own payment authorization call also times out, pointing to downstream latency rather than gateway-local failure.
